_comment: 来源：mod 仓库 _docs/data/units/稻荷灵狐使者兵种设计.md；name 取 loc land_units_onscreen_name，desc／story 取 loc unit_description_short_texts／unit_description_historical_texts（中英原文）。本兵种没有技能，部队属性全部是 DB 属性。

role.zh: 高机动魔法战兽 · T2 · 侧袭骚扰
role.en: Fast magical war beasts · T2 · flanking and harassment

v.zh: 战争野兽（多体战兽） · 近战
船上神龛（1 级）→ 船上神乐殿（2 级）→ 船上稻荷本社（3 级）→ 麟栖神宫（4 级）舰上稻荷社链；稻荷神社（1 级）／稻荷神乐殿（2 级）／稻荷大社（3 级）／灵兽神宫（4 级）陆上神社链；灵道拜殿／灵道本殿／灵道御先殿（地标）
v.en: Shipboard Shrine (tier 1) → Shipboard Kagura Hall (2) → Shipboard Inari Main Shrine (3) → Kirin Roost Sanctuary (4) in the Shipboard Inari Shrine chain; Inari Shrine (tier 1) / Inari Kagura Hall (2) / Inari Grand Shrine (3) / Divine Beast Sanctuary (4) in the Shrine chain on land; Great Shrine Outer Sanctuary / Great Shrine Inner Sanctuary / Great Shrine Messenger Hall (landmark)

v.zh: 建成上述任一建筑（最低 1 级神龛即可招募）
v.en: Building any of the above (the tier 1 Shipboard Shrine is enough)

desc.zh: 灵力爪牙伤害按魔法计算
desc.en: Its spirit claws and fangs deal magical damage
